title: Self-Pay Terms: Unpaid Balance Addition to the In-Person Appointments Booking Deposit
content:
**Clause.** The booking deposit on an In-Person Appointments visit takes an addition according to the unpaid balance counted for it, drawn from the unpaid balance on the patient's Patient Financial Account:

- where the unpaid balance counted for the booking deposit is **above 100.00** dollars, **50.00** dollars are added to the booking deposit;
- where it is **above zero and up to 100.00** dollars, **25.00** dollars are added;
- where it is **zero or less**, nothing is added.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical balances).**

| Unpaid balance counted | Addition |
|---|---|
| $100.01 | 50.00 dollars |
| $100.00 | 25.00 dollars |
| $0.01 | 25.00 dollars |
| $0.00 | nothing |
| a credit of $12.00 (below zero) | nothing |

Exactly 100.00 dollars falls in the second band; the first band starts only above it.
